comment: By far my favorite professor in the entire university as well as the Jepson School. Dr. Hicks is extremely intelligent and very helpful. He cares a lot about his students and is always willing to meet with you. Take whatever class he teaches it will be worth it!
Egotistical and very flighty as a teacher. Nice enough person outside the classroom.

Prof. Hicks is an awesome guy in and out of the classroom. He's one of the leading scholars in leadership studies and really knows his stuff. I look forward to this class and love how discussion based it is. You have to do the readings to do well and must really familiarize yourself with the material, but if you put in an effort you'll be fine.

Dr. Hicks is an awesome professor! He is very involved in what he does and you will learn a lot from him! His classes are based on students reading for homework and then the class is all discussion, so you have to read! He is very funny and really nice and I would take him again in a heart beat! (He has 2-3 essays, a midterm and a final)

Dr. Hicks is the best professor I have had at UR. If you are interested in Leadership Studies at all, take his class! He is so kind and incredibly smart. He wants you to do well and will make every effort to make sure you do. Class is challenging but worth it. Definitely take his class if you have the opportunity!!
He has the kindest heart, and is continually willing to hear you out during class or even afterwards. Is always keen on clarifying for students and helping along. Grades fairly, but hard.

I definitely recommend taking his class. He's such a great guy, and great professor. I've learned so much, and his class discussions are meant to get everyone actively involved. Absolutely one of my favorite classes. Lots of reading... you can't get by without doing it.

Excellent professor and fascinating course that is team-taught. Discussion and some lecture with midterm and final exams and a four-person group project with powerpoint presentation and 20-page paper.  He is brilliant with knowledge of leadership, economics, ethics and religion. Kind and really interested in students' success. No sleeping in class.

Outstanding professor; excellent readings; good pace.  Compassionate and caring; very busy, though he will always make time to see students. Dry sense of humor; loves Duke basketball.  Not consistently in his office for office hours.  Leads applause for latecomers - be prompt.  Midterm and final, with two papers.  Discussion based with lecture.

Dr. Hicks is a genius that has a huge heart. He's a big help and leads very effective discussions. Service to Society was a fun class with relatively easy readings, and his grading was so fair. Awesome guy.
